covers: US session Tuesday 3 November, US midterm results overnight and Asian trade to about 06:00 SAST Wednesday 4 November (JSE closed today for local elections)
headline: Democrats projected to win the US House; Nasdaq-100 futures fall nearly 2% and the dollar drops, while AMD beats and guides to about $17 billion
summary: Decision Desk HQ projected overnight that Democrats will win control of the US House, with the Senate still contested; Nasdaq-100 futures were down nearly 2% and S&P 500 futures about 1.1% at 04:46 SAST on worries that a Democratic Congress would slow the AI data-centre build-out (Yahoo Finance/Stocktwits, 3–4 Nov). The dollar index fell 0.3% to 101.4, the euro rose to $1.1249 and spot gold was little changed at $3,931 an ounce, while Brent eased towards $103 (Reuters, 4 Nov). The JSE is closed today for local elections, so the rand (R16.64/$ on Tuesday afternoon) trades offshore and local shares only react on Thursday.

items.title: Decision Desk HQ projects Democrats will win the US House; Senate still contested
items.summary: Decision Desk HQ projected on Tuesday night US time that Democrats will take control of the House of Representatives (report published 04:21 SAST Wednesday). Earlier, Democrats Jon Ossoff (Georgia) and Mark Warner (Virginia) won re-election to the Senate, and Reuters said control of the Senate was still contested. Prediction market Kalshi put a Democratic House win at about 97% and Senate at about 90% (Stocktwits via Yahoo Finance). A split government would make new tax or spending laws harder to pass for the final two years of President Trump's term.
items.source: Yahoo News, 4 Nov 2026; Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 4 Nov 2026; Stocktwits via Yahoo Finance, 3 Nov 2026

items.title: Nasdaq-100 futures down nearly 2%, S&P 500 futures −1.13%, Dow futures −0.76% at 04:46 SAST
items.summary: US stock futures fell as early results pointed to a Democratic sweep: at 21:46 New York time (04:46 SAST) Nasdaq-100 futures were down nearly 2%, S&P 500 futures down about 1.13% and Dow futures down about 0.76%. Investors expect a Democratic Congress to push for more limits on data centres, which would hit AI build-out stocks. Trump Media (DJT) was down more than 7% overnight. In Asia, Japan's Nikkei fell 1.5% after a holiday while South Korean stocks rose more than 2% early (Reuters).
items.source: Stocktwits via Yahoo Finance, 3 Nov 2026; Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 4 Nov 2026

items.title: Tuesday close: Nasdaq +0.83% to 25,372.01, S&P 500 +0.36% to 7,568.92, Dow −0.38% to 51,786.72
items.summary: Tech led on Tuesday 3 November before the election results: the Nasdaq Composite closed up 0.83% at 25,372.01 and the S&P 500 up 0.36% at 7,568.92, while the Dow fell 0.38% to 51,786.72. The gains were wiped out in overnight futures trade as the midterm results came in.

items.title: Dollar index −0.3% to 101.4 as Democrats gain; euro $1.1249, yen 157.63
items.summary: Reuters reported the dollar index down 0.3% at 101.4 in Asian trade on Wednesday, with the euro up 0.5% to $1.1249, sterling up 0.4% to $1.3460, the yen 0.7% stronger at 157.63 per dollar and the Swiss franc up 0.9% (dollar at 0.8133). A weaker dollar usually supports emerging-market currencies such as the rand.

items.title: JSE closed today for local elections; rand last at R16.64/$ on Tuesday
items.summary: South Africans vote in municipal elections today, Wednesday 4 November, and the JSE is closed. On Tuesday at 15:04 SAST the rand traded at R16.6425/$, about 0.3% weaker, the Top 40 was down about 0.7% and the 2035 bond yield fell 1.5 basis points to 8.52% (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 3 Nov). The rand will trade offshore today against a weaker dollar; JSE shares react to the US results on Thursday.

items.title: New fuel prices in force from today: diesel down R1.10–R1.20 a litre, petrol down 1c
items.summary: From 00:01 on Wednesday 4 November, 93 and 95 petrol fall 1c a litre, diesel 0.05% falls R1.10 and diesel 0.005% R1.20, while illuminating paraffin (wholesale) rises R2.75 a litre and LPGas R1.83/kg, per the Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources. The general fuel levy cut (R1.50/l petrol, R3/l diesel) is partly offset by a new slate levy of 135.84c/l. Cheaper diesel helps transport, farming and mining costs (Stuff, 3 Nov).

items.title: US letter gives 60 days' notice: SA's AGOA status to end on 1 January 2027
items.summary: BusinessTech reports that President Trump wrote to President Ramaphosa giving 60 days' notice that South Africa's AGOA trade beneficiary status will end on 1 January 2027, citing slow progress on corruption and trade barriers, and foreign policy concerns. Exporters of vehicles, citrus and other farm goods are the most exposed. On Monday the rand gained about 0.4% to R16.64/$ and traded at R16.62/$ on Tuesday morning; the Top-40 rose about 1% and the 2035 bond yield fell 2.5 basis points to 8.565%. NAAMSA new vehicle sales rose 10.4% year on year in October.

items.title: Gold $3,931 (+0.1%); platinum −1.9% to $1,389.54; silver −1.3% to $49.12
items.summary: Spot gold was up 0.1% at $3,931.24 an ounce at 05:06 SAST and December US gold futures steady at $3,941.40. Spot silver fell 1.3% to $49.12, platinum 1.9% to $1,389.54 and palladium 0.6% to $928.23 (Reuters). Weaker platinum is a headwind for JSE PGM miners when trading resumes on Thursday.

items.title: Oil edges lower: about $103.34 a barrel after Tuesday's 1% fall
items.summary: Reuters reported crude edging lower on Wednesday to about $103.34 a barrel after falling about 1% on Tuesday, as traders weighed US–Iran peace talks and the US election results.

items.title: AMD (LRC Stock Scanner: HOLD, target $641.00) beats: revenue $13.38 billion, data centre +97%, Q4 guide about $17 billion
items.summary: AMD's third-quarter revenue rose 45% to $13.38 billion and adjusted EPS rose 74% to $2.09, ahead of estimates of $13.06 billion and $1.94; data centre revenue nearly doubled (+97%) to $8.55 billion. It guided fourth-quarter revenue to about $17 billion (±3%), against consensus of $16.23 billion (AMD; Investing.com, 3 Nov). Shares rose more than 7% after hours, but were up only about 4% by 04:46 SAST as Nasdaq futures fell (Stocktwits via Yahoo Finance). The scanner's last price was $486.40 (3 Nov, 18:45 SAST run), well below its $641.00 target. The rating is not changed here.
items.source: AMD, 3 Nov 2026; Investing.com, 3 Nov 2026; Stocktwits via Yahoo Finance, 3 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner, 3 Nov 2026

items.title: Super Micro (LRC Stock Scanner: HOLD, target $62.57) up more than 4% overnight on results
items.summary: Super Micro shares were up more than 4% in overnight trade after first-quarter revenue nearly quadrupled to about $20 billion, per Stocktwits (3 Nov). On 20 October the company had pre-announced revenue of $18.5–19.5 billion and a 12.0–12.5% gross margin, above its earlier guide of $14.5–15.5 billion (Supermicro, 20 Oct). The scanner shows HOLD with a $62.57 target against a last price of $31.29 (3 Nov). The rating is not changed here.
items.source: Stocktwits via Yahoo Finance, 3 Nov 2026; Supermicro, 20 Oct 2026; LRC Stock Scanner, 3 Nov 2026

items.title: AI names in the firing line: Nasdaq-100 futures −2% hit NVIDIA (BUY, target $239.30) and Meta (HOLD, target $547.40)
items.summary: Overnight selling was aimed at AI build-out stocks on fears a Democratic Congress will add data-centre limits (Stocktwits via Yahoo Finance, 3 Nov). The scanner shows NVIDIA at BUY with a $239.30 target (last $207.80) and Meta at HOLD with a $547.40 target (last $620.20), both from the 3 Nov 18:45 SAST run. Individual pre-market prices were not verified, so none are given. Ratings are not changed here.
items.source: Stocktwits via Yahoo Finance, 3 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner, 3 Nov 2026
